purpose: Bind the three blinded reviewer packages before the composition reads them, so the composition reads hash-bound bytes rather than working-tree state.
commit_sha_note: This receipt is staged inside the commit it describes and cannot contain that commit's own sha. The dispatching session records it in the queue's archive_binding, where research_dispatch.py verifies it.
binding_mode_note: content_first: every path bound here is a filed review report, which is write-once and which nothing reranks, so verifying the declared hashes at HEAD is the stricter choice and catches an in-place edit to a report after it was filed. NOT content_at_commit, and the distinction is live in this goal: CORR-20260921-f5e9c4 records that BATCH-9d649f bound the SHARED APPEND-ONLY tools/run_supersession_registry.yaml under content_first, which left this goal undispatchable once unrelated campaigns appended to it. The rule that separates the two cases is whether the bound file is allowed to change, not which mode is stricter in the abstract.
path_sha256_note: Ten entries: every declared artifact of the three reviewers. Computed by the archiving session from the blobs with `git show HEAD:<path>`, not from the working tree.

the_rederivation_hash_independently_corr.what: TASK-20260921-f1e5bd reported that it wrote and hashed rederived.json at e545eda2 and timestamped it 19:55:23Z BEFORE opening the producer's summary.json.
the_rederivation_hash_independently_corr.what_this_archive_adds: The blob committed at this archive hashes to e545eda29353734b8a50f592d9636957055d23221183387f2eecaf24cabbee15, which matches the value the reviewer reported. So the file whose ordering the reviewer attests to is the file bound here, and the attestation is about these exact bytes rather than about some earlier draft.
the_rederivation_hash_independently_corr.what_it_does_NOT_establish: The ORDERING itself. A hash cannot show what was read when; only that the artifact was not altered afterwards. The ordering rests on the reviewer's attestation, which is what an attestation is for.

the_source_artifacts_were_ALREADY_COMMIT.what: All ten reviewer artifacts were landed by tools/producer_landing.py in the turn each reviewer returned -- 6f1902a44 (J-1), fed1b8c21 (J-2), ec3b333df (J-3) -- so this commit stages only its own receipt.
the_source_artifacts_were_ALREADY_COMMIT.why: It is the CORR-20260921-942a62 remedy. The gap between production and archival is what destroyed an earlier round in this program: a producer's output sat as an unowned working-tree artifact and the machine went away with it.
the_source_artifacts_were_ALREADY_COMMIT.landing_reported: Each reviewer: declared 3, 3 and 4 artifacts, all on disk, all landed, and a following --check over the whole queue reported no unlanded output and NOTHING UNDECLARED in any producer's write scope. No reviewer wrote more than it declared.
the_source_artifacts_were_ALREADY_COMMIT.cost_stated_plainly: This commit is not where a later reader learns when a report first existed; the landing commits are. Same disclosure TASK-20260916-92128f's receipt makes in the sibling goal.

independence_qualifications_the_reviewer.why_recorded_here: An independence qualification discovered later is far worse than one written down at the archive. Both below were volunteered by the reviewer rather than found by audit, which is the behaviour the round wants.
independence_qualifications_the_reviewer.TASK-20260921-f2d82f: Read the review plan's `proves_too_much` and `blind_rederivation` blocks -- which are OUTSIDE its declared blind_from set, so this is a disclosure rather than a breach -- and did so only AFTER completing every J-1 computation. It named one sentence in those blocks as close in spirit to a Coordinator prior, and deliberately declined to report on the control object the plan assigns to J-2. It confirms `coordinator_prior` and both sibling task directories were never opened.
independence_qualifications_the_reviewer.TASK-20260921-411a9d: Ran one read-only `git status --porcelain` to confirm it had not written outside its scope, against a card bound saying to run no git command. Recorded by the reviewer as PD-RT-1. It changed nothing, staged nothing, and opened no sibling file. The composition carries this into the round's `procedure_deviations` rather than absorbing it.
independence_qualifications_the_reviewer.TASK-20260921-f1e5bd: Discloses a LIMIT ON ACHIEVABLE BLINDNESS rather than a departure: the raw results.jsonl files EMBED the producer's per-instance derived scalars, so blindness to the producer's NUMBERS was not achievable from this package. Blindness to its IMPLEMENTATION was achievable and was maintained -- rederive.py deletes the producer's derived scalars programmatically before deriving and parses the raw engine logs itself -- and the d_F4 convention divergence it found is evidence that it held. It also discloses that closure_D rests on the producer's linear algebra, which a zero-run task cannot recompute.
independence_qualifications_the_reviewer.no_undeclared_sibling_reads: All three attest that they did not open each other's directories, and the concurrent dispatch means no reviewer could have seen another's output: the three ran in parallel and none had returned when the others started.

what_the_three_joints_returned.J-1_validity: BREAKS, narrowly, and not where the run's numbers are. completed_valid is not falsified, but byte identity was reframed into a form with zero detection power and declared code identity is broken for 4 of 11 modules against a dirty tree. The duplicate audit was computed and is CLEAN: zero discordant pairs.
what_the_three_joints_returned.J-2_the_map: BREAKS. The contract's declared metric was never computed -- the metric NAME is bound to the value closure_D, which is F4-side by its own definition -- so the headline is an agreement between two F4-side quantities, and this run does not earn completion criterion 1.
what_the_three_joints_returned.J-3_rederivation: HOLDS. The headline reproduces exactly, and on ELEVEN instances rather than the producer's nine, convention-independently. One definitional divergence in d_F4 localised to two named implementations, reaching no separation.
what_the_three_joints_returned.note_on_composition: Each reviewer reported on its own joints only, as the plan requires. A blinded reviewer cannot see the other joints by construction, so no verdict above is a verdict on the run as a whole. TASK-20260921-a9f304 composes them.

validation.hash_provenance: every declared hash computed from a git blob, not from the working tree

what_this_archive_does_not_do: It composes nothing and adjudicates nothing. Three joint verdicts are not a verdict.
It does not decide whether RUN-SEMBIN-b6eb9f is valid overall, whether the map stands, or whether completion criterion 1 is met. Those are the composition's.
It moves no hypothesis, writes no evidence record, and changes no status.
It asserts nothing about Semaev's Assumption 1 or Assumption 2, about d_F4, d_reg, GOAL-DREG-001, any elliptic curve, or the security of any deployed parameter set.
It does not edit any reviewer's package. All ten files are bound exactly as filed.

executed_by_the_dispatching_coordinator_.what: The card expected an agent at executor-mechanical; the coordinator session executed it directly.
executed_by_the_dispatching_coordinator_.why: Staging one receipt and hashing ten already-committed blobs is judgement-free by construction.
executed_by_the_dispatching_coordinator_.what_is_lost_by_it: An independent pair of eyes on the staging step. Recorded rather than glossed: the commit was reviewed only by its author, and a reader who thinks every archive should be a separate session has a legitimate objection.
executed_by_the_dispatching_coordinator_.effort_note: The card requests executor-mechanical, whose policy default is `low`; this session runs at the coordinator policy's effort, which is HIGHER than requested. Rule 11 permits a stronger tier than a card asks for and forbids a weaker one.
